description: This file defines an abstract base class for JSON-based grain storage providers in an Orleans application. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as serializing and deserializing JSON data.

classes.name: BaseJSONStorageProvider
classes.description: An abstract class implementing IGrainStorage for JSON-based storage, providing common functionality for derived storage providers.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider and disposes of the data manager.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads persisted grain state from storage and deserializes it into the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes the grain state to storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Removes the grain state from storage.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state to a JSON string.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into grain state.
